item.title: Silent Exfiltration via Malicious Skills in LLM Agents: Supply Chain Risk for Developers
item.description: A proof-of-concept attack where a seemingly legitimate skill for ‘code search’ silently exfiltrates a repository when wired into an LLM agent, illustrating supply chain risks in agent skills and tools.
